title: How is the yearly rent on a Safe Deposit Box calculated?
content:
## Scope

This calculation guide covers how the yearly rent charged on a rental in the Safe Deposit Boxes line is worked out: the base rent for the box size, the adjustment for the rental's branch, and the single discount chosen for that rental.

## Policy clause

1. The **gross rent** is the annual base rent for the box size, increased or reduced by the branch rent adjustment percent for the rental's branch, rounded half-up to the cent.
2. The **net rent** charged is the gross rent less the single discount chosen for that rental under the rules for allocating rent discounts, rounded half-up to the cent. The discount percent is taken off the gross rent as already rounded in step 1.

## Annual base rent

| Official box size | Annual rent before branch adjustment and discounts |
|---|---|
| 3x5 Safe Deposit Box | $65.00 |
| 3x10 Safe Deposit Box | $85.00 |
| 5x10 Safe Deposit Box | $120.00 |
| 10x10 Safe Deposit Box | $175.00 |
| 10x15 Safe Deposit Box | $240.00 |
| 10x20 Safe Deposit Box | $325.00 |

## Branch rent adjustment

The adjustment is the same for every box size.

| Branch | Adjustment to the base rent |
|---|---|
| Greensboro Main Office | None (0 percent) |
| Winston-Salem Reynolda Road | None (0 percent) |
| Charlotte SouthPark | Increased by 15 percent |
| Raleigh North Hills | Increased by 10 percent |
| Greenville Main Street | None (0 percent) |
| Roanoke Market Square | Reduced by 5 percent |

## Gross rent, worked out from the two tables

| Official box size | No adjustment | Charlotte SouthPark | Raleigh North Hills | Roanoke Market Square |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3x5 Safe Deposit Box | $65.00 | $74.75 | $71.50 | $61.75 |
| 3x10 Safe Deposit Box | $85.00 | $97.75 | $93.50 | $80.75 |
| 5x10 Safe Deposit Box | $120.00 | $138.00 | $132.00 | $114.00 |
| 10x10 Safe Deposit Box | $175.00 | $201.25 | $192.50 | $166.25 |
| 10x15 Safe Deposit Box | $240.00 | $276.00 | $264.00 | $228.00 |
| 10x20 Safe Deposit Box | $325.00 | $373.75 | $357.50 | $308.75 |

"No adjustment" applies to Greensboro Main Office, Winston-Salem Reynolda Road and Greenville Main Street. Where the rental receives no discount, nothing is taken off and the net rent is the gross rent.

## Worked example with a hypothetical discount

A 3x5 box at Charlotte SouthPark, with a hypothetical chosen discount of 30 percent:

1. Base rent $65.00, increased by 15 percent of $65.00, which is $9.75, gives a gross rent of $74.75.
2. 30 percent of $74.75 is $22.425; $74.75 less $22.425 is $52.325.
3. Rounded half-up to the cent, the net rent charged is $52.33.

## Wrong reading and correct basis

| Wrong reading | Result | Correct basis |
|---|---|---|
| Net the branch increase against the discount first (15 percent up and 30 percent off treated as 15 percent off the base rent). | $55.25 | The branch adjustment produces the gross rent first; the discount is then taken off that gross rent. Correct result $52.33. |
| Round a half cent down or to the even cent. | $52.32 | Rounding is half-up to the cent. |
| Apply the discount to the base rent and ignore the branch adjustment. | $45.50 | The discount acts on the gross rent, which already includes the branch adjustment. |
